edits.headline: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they seized US underwater drone
edits.subheadline: The Guards said their naval forces captured an unmanned US submarine at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, AFP reported.
editorialBody: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said their naval forces captured an unmanned US submarine at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, AFP reported.

An Iranian missile attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan on September 8 severely damaged a US A-10 aircraft and lightly damaged about eight F-15E jets, Air & Space Forces Magazine reported, citing CBS News. US officials said no American personnel were killed.

The Alternative for Germany won 43.8% of the vote in the Saxony-Anhalt state election on September 6, according to preliminary final results, NPR reported. The party fell just short of an absolute majority.
The SEC's rewrite of its crypto custody rules has entered White House review, The Defiant reported.
